steps.text: Withdrawn suggestion: borrow three processor units. The operative step instead borrows two processor units from the pool, adds no storage units, and retains these borrowed units until a later return step.
While keeping the processor units already held, additionally borrow two storage units from the pool. This step acquires no further processor units.
Return the two processor units and the two storage units held by this job to the pool. This step acquires nothing and ends the job.
Borrow two storage units from the pool and retain them for subsequent steps. Do not borrow any processor units in this step.
Keeping the two storage units already borrowed, additionally borrow two processor units. The earlier proposal of one processor unit is withdrawn; two is the operative quantity.
Return two processor units together with two storage units to the pool. No units remain held after this final step.
